# Nourish instructions

- Product name is the constant in `src/config/brand.ts`. Guide name is Disha. Light mode only.
- Do not invent statistics, testimonials, or official logos. V0 data stays labelled demo data.
- The model must not write fact digits. Use `{{fact:ID}}`, `{{range:ID}}`, `{{rate:ID}}` and the number guard.
- Family UI hides `pending_verification` rows. Cohort fallback is centre → district → state, else say there is no verified data.
- Footer on every page: Prototype for Smart India Hackathon 2026 — not an official government portal.
- Re-verify Fact Pack URLs and helplines before a live demo.
- Prefer small typed modules. No placeholder buttons.
